einzeiler: Preview of Season 2 of the Energy Curfew Music Hour featuring live acoustic performances
kurzfassung: This episode offers a preview of the second season of the Energy Curfew Music Hour, recorded live at Minetta Lane Theatre in New York City. Host Chris Thiele and the Punch Brothers are joined by guests including Michelle Indegeocello, Justin Hicks, and Sara Bareilles. The show combines intimate acoustic music with satirical announcements about energy curfews and green technology.
stichpunkte: Chris Thiele and the Punch Brothers present the second season preview of the Energy Curfew Music Hour
Recorded live at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre in New York City
Special guests include Michelle Indegeocello, Justin Hicks, and Sara Bareilles
Fictional sponsors include ATM Plus Lotto and Jelly Jar jellyfish-powered amplifiers
Features all-acoustic live musical performances and collaborative jams

clips.text: The host explains the motivation behind creating an intimate setting for live musical teamwork while introducing the upcoming season.

clips.hook: A cash machine that combines banking with gambling
clips.text: A satirical commercial presents an automated teller machine designed to turn routine withdrawals into betting opportunities.

clips.hook: True fortune lies within the surrounding lawns and weeds
clips.text: The lyrics shift focus toward the value found in ordinary outdoor spaces rather than ornamental plant petals.

beschreibung:
The Grammy-winning Punch Brothers, fronted by Chris Thile, are back for Season 2, bringing you a multi-episode collaborative musical variety show with dazzling musical guests like Billy Strings, Sara Bareilles, Jacob Collier, Shawn Mendes, Meshell Ndegeocello, Andrew Bird, Cecile McLorin Salvant and many more.
We join them in an imagined near future when diminishing resources have ushered in a worldwide effort to ration electricity. America has instituted a weekly “energy curfew” where the power grid goes down completely and we all live electricity-free for 24 hours. The Energy Curfew Music Hour hits the airwaves an hour before the lights go out while the nation tunes in and turns off together before the Dark Day.
Recorded live in front of an audience, revel in the wild and wonderful joy unleashed in these one-night-only performances. Chris Thile and Punch Brothers help you wind down before you power down. Happy Dark Day, y’all. Sign up for a 30 day free trial to listen to The Energy Curfew Music Hour Season 2 exclusively on Audible: audible.com/curfew.

Episode 1: SPRING (Sara Bareilles and Meshell Ndegeocello)
Episode 2: SPACE (Jacob Collier and Tune-Yards)
Episode 3: SUMMER (Shawn Mendes, Cécile McLorin Salvant, Sullivan Fortner)
Episode 4: FALL (Andrew Bird and Nate Smith)
Episode 5: SEA (I’m With Her and Amos Lee)
Episode 6: WINTER (Billy Strings and Jesca Hoop)
